title: Say Hi to Shop: The Shopping Experience Designed Around Shoppers
summary: Shop is a shopping experience featuring stores built on Shopify. Shoppers love its faster checkout, unified order tracking, and personalized brand discovery.
body_markdown:
Millions of shoppers around the world use Shop to discover stores they love, speed through checkout, and track every order.


Shop is many things to many shoppers. For some, it '


s the purple button they use to check out faster at their favorite online stores. For others, Shop is the app they use to track all their packages. And for others, Shop is where they go to do all their shopping. ****


That '


s the beauty of Shop. It gives shoppers a better way to do everything. All in one place. Best of all, Shop is optimized for each individual shopper.


## Buy with Shop: the purple button ****


As a shopper, all you have to do is sign into Shop once. Then you breeze through checkout everywhere. ****


Just tap the purple Buy with Shop button at checkout, and your info preloads automatically. Name. Shipping address. Payment info. It '


s all there. No more typing in your email for the hundredth time. No more sharing your card number with stores you only just discovered. ****


Buying with Shop even gives you the flexibility to pay now or over time. It '


s totally up to you.


## Shop app: the place where shoppers love to shop ****


Shop is also a shopping destination, both[on the web](https://shop.app/) and[in the app](https://shop.app/download) .


It '


s where you go to browse stores you love: the independent labels, the cult favorites, the local gems. Shop feels like walking through a well-curated shopping district. Not wading through a soulless megastore packed with identical products from anonymous sellers. ****


You can find anything on Shop, from the perfect running shoes to your favorite brand of dental floss. Search for specific products, categories, or brands. Or just describe what you '


re looking for in a few simple words, then let Shop guide you to finds that match your unique taste and style.


And the more you use Shop, the better it gets. Get recommendations inspired by what you search, save, and buy—both on Shop anywhere you use the purple "


Buy with Shop "


button. Score deals and offers created just for you. ****


Over time, your feed feels like it '


s custom-made just for you. Because it actually is.


## All your stores. All your order tracking. All in one spot. ****


It all comes together in the Shop app. You can follow your favorite stores to see what '


s new. Or save and organize items you '


re still thinking about, so they '


re on hand when you '


re ready to buy. ****


Shop even collects all your carts for you. Start shopping at stores across the web, then finish checking out later on Shop. No more endless open browser tabs. ****


Then there's the[unified order tracking](https://help.shop.app/en/shop/delivery-tracking) that so many shoppers rely on Shop for. Get real-time delivery updates from every store, from the moment you check out to when the package hits your doorstep. No more digging through your inbox, looking for shipping confirmations.


## Safe and sound ****


Shoppers trust Shop for many reasons. ****


All your shipping and payment information is securely encrypted. And Shop makes it easy to report any suspicious stores, content, or order issues right from the app. ****


And Shop is built by Shopify, one of the most trusted names in commerce. Each store has to meet Shopify's high standards to be included on Shop—not every store and product makes the cut.


## How everything fits together ****


**Shop**


The whole interconnected shopping experience.


**The Shop app**
[iOS](https://shop.app/download) ,[Android](https://shop.app/download)


The mobile home of Shop. Shoppers can discover products, save stuff for later, pay fast, and track orders.


**[Shop.app](https://shop.app/)**


The online home of Shop. Similar to the app, but designed for the web.


**Buy with Shop**


Accelerated checkout available at millions of online stores. Previously known to shoppers as "Shop Pay."


**Shopify**


Shop is built by Shopify, the world '


s best commerce platform.


**Stores on Shop**


Shop features millions of stores built on Shopify.


When merchants join Shopify, their products are automatically discoverable on Shop.


When shoppers buy on Shop, they '


re buying directly from the individual store. Stores are responsible for fulfilling each order, and handle their own returns and refund policies.


Best of all: stores don '


t pay extra to sell on Shop, which means they keep more of what they make.


## Give Shop a shot ****


How it works:


1.


**Find something good.** Discover products at stores across the web or on the app ([download the app](https://shop.app/download) ).


2.


**Tap to buy.** Use the purple button to pay.


3.


**Stay in the loop.** Your order and delivery updates land in the Shop app automatically.


4.


**Make Shop yours.** Save products, follow stores, and watch your recommendations get more and more you. Because the more you use Shop, the more you it gets. (Update your[personalization and privacy settings](https://help.shop.app/en/shop/getting-started/manage-settings/data-privacy-settings) anytime.)


To get started,[explore Shop on the web](https://shop.app/) or[download the app](https://shop.app/download) .
